name: Sun Cleric: Exorcism already makes Sanctify dispel one additional effect per type (#1571)
contract: 300341 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x4000. Sanctify (524968) carries that exact bit in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 1 (0x4000). SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND matches. Its own BasePoints is unset (0), resolving to 1 (DieSides 1), matching 'Sanctify now dispels 1 additional effect'. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS unconditionally before any per-index modifier, so the +1 lands on all three of Sanctify's SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL effects (indices 0, 1, 2), each removing one more affliction of its own dispel type. Native only, no server code needed.
